project.title: Eukaryotic sequencing of advanced waste water treatment
project.description: We analysed the eukaryotic diversity of a waste water treatment plant effluent, a novel MABR reactor and a subsequent ecological reservoir to associate eukaryotic diversity with reduction in pathogen and AMR load during treatment.
